map.平面应力 von Mises 等效应力（本页代码口径，应力按 Pa 输入）：σ_: Plane-stress von Mises equivalent stress (code convention of this page, stresses in Pa): σ_vm = √(σx² − σx·σy + σy² + 3τ²); linked values: equivalent stress ignoring shear σ_vm0 = √(σx² − σx·σy + σy²), maximum shear stress τ_max = √(((σx − σy) ÷ 2)² + τ²), all divided by 10⁶ and reported in MPa. Validation: sx, sy and t are required; an empty value returns "Please enter the necessary parameters before calculating." and stops (no 0 fallback). Criterion: no fixed grading; for uniaxial stress σ_vm = |σx|, for pure shear σ_vm = √3×|τ|, and the main result keeps two decimals.
